title: Estados más fuertes
goal: Read how early twentieth-century Latin American states professionalized their armies, built real tax systems, and expanded bureaucratic reach beyond the nineteenth century's chronic weakness.
grammar: Pretérito perfecto compuesto: lo que los Estados han logrado

items: Explain what this institutional strengthening contrasts with.
State what governments replaced when they professionalized their armies.
Explain what the state had depended on before creating new tax systems.
Describe the new bureaucratic institutions states expanded.
Use the present perfect (haber + participle) to connect a past process to its ongoing relevance.
